paper_title: Galactic axions search with a superconducting resonant cavity
notes: QUAX-agamma haloscope with NbTi superconducting cavity at LNL. Single-mass search: 95% CL upper limit g_agamma < 1.03e-12 GeV^-1 over a 45 kHz band at nu_c = 9.067 GHz, corresponding to a ~0.2 neV mass window around m_a ~ 37.5 ueV. Encoded as a flat two-point line spanning the narrow band. Assumed local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Paper also mentions a future projection (g < 4e-14 GeV^-1 with upgraded setup), but the primary result is the measured limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
